changelog:
🏠 The admin panel now opens at the site root (http://host:8080/). Old /admin links redirect to the same page, and the admin API stays at /admin/api.
🧰 Client setup builds a ready-to-run request for the Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions and OpenAI Responses APIs in curl, Python, Node.js, Go, Java, PHP, Ruby and C#, with the official SDK or plain HTTP.
🧮 Endpoints lists the token count endpoint, POST /v1/messages/count_tokens.
🪟 Add account opens as a split pane: every sign-in and import method in a side rail, the chosen one beside it.
🧪 The model tester's picker keeps its footer in view, with one Select all for the models shown.
🖥️ The sidebar's Admin row shows a server icon with a live proxy dot, and the icon rail shows the app icon.
🔧 Fixed: the proxy advertises the current Kiro IDE release, 1.4.154.
🔧 Fixed: client snippets use the auto model, which every account serves.
🔧 Fixed: a text selection in a field hugs the words.
